Rule details:
Checks for .srt files matching selected video names. If found, creates folder '_video_out/{VideoName}-{ext}' and copies SRT file as '{LangCode}.srt'.

After completion, select these videos in the main interface to automatically attach subtitles. Do NOT click [Save To...] or [Clear Generated].
